//: No applicationUrl anywhere in this file, deliberately. Program.cs is the single place that binds ports — 5220 HTTP, plus 7288 HTTPS once certs/homehub-dev.* exist — on 0.0.0.0 (not localhost) so tablets and phones on the LAN reach the panel at http://<host-ip>:5220. Declaring the same ports here as well is what made Kestrel log 'Overriding address(es)' on every start: the two sources never disagreed, there were simply two of them.
